text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":200,"unit":"students","kind":"count","span":"class of 200"},{"id":"q2","value":3,"unit":"groups","kind":"count","span":"split into 3"},{"id":"q3","value":10,"unit":"students","kind":"count","span":"10 less than"}],"plan":[{"op":"add","args":["q1","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"add the 10-student deficit back, as if all three groups were the same size"},{"op":"div","args":["s1","q2"],"out":"s2","note":"divide by the number of groups (3) to get one equal-sized group"},{"op":"sub","args":["s2","q3"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract 10 again to get the actual smallest group's size"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"number of students in the smallest group"},"dismissed":[{"value":2,"reason":"count of the two equal-sized groups; not needed since the derivation uses the total number of groups (3) instead"}]}
